name: DC Hub
tagline: Live data center, power, grid, fiber and deal data for AI agents and site selection.
description: DC Hub is the live data layer for data-center site selection. Its Data Center Power Index (DCPI) is a daily score of where data centers can get grid power, across 300+ markets. The remote server exposes 94 MCP tools covering markets, power and grid, ISO interconnection queues and electricity prices; answers carry an as-of timestamp and a citation line. Free to start, no key needed for the free tier.
